research.notes: Mathnasium is a franchised math tutoring chain. Search results show at least two separate Oakland centers (Rockridge, 4971 Broadway; Redwood Heights, 4100 Redwood Rd) plus a corporate parent (Mathnasium LLC), and the agenda's 'Mathnasium, Inc.' could not be matched to any one of them. Mathnasium.com blocks automated fetching (HTTP 403), and no registry record for 'Mathnasium, Inc.' was verified. Not confident which legal entity OUSD contracted with, so no profile was published.
